title: Audit uniform Beneš compiler with charged sequential arena scans
body:
This isolates the Beneš compiler/query component of Cinna Davis’s PR4100 CRT.md §2. For a canonically encoded permutation on N=2^h wires with1<=h<=p, the written uniform lowering has O(N³(p+2)^7) time and O(N(p+2)^3) visited space. It preserves the source, serializes an owned network, clears private workspace and returns heads on fixed reusable tape roles.

The implementation flattens recursion, stores the DFS stack in a tagged arena, and performs a complete scan and return for every logical get/put. The proof derives exact record count N(h²+3h+1), access count N²+2Nh²+(37Nh−35N)/2, and tape-action invoices. Python scalar/header operations are lowered in the written proof; the executed arena/key model is not a complete finite-state transition-table certificate. The original cycle compiler and full-scan proposal remain credited predecessor work.

All six registered normal/optimized commands passed. Primary49cases reproduce the exact retained tables and1,260queries, with15,984logicalaccesses and3,583,480record scans. Contiguous tape macros are checked against expanded one-cell execution. The separately written preimplementation FIFO oracle checks40,394permutations/324,452endpoint columns/1,630,756controls; a hash-pinned direct cross-check adds37cases/848queries. Semantic/admission/head-return controls detect their intended faults. Exact committed bytes and declared source ancestry pass.

This takes the encoded permutation as input. Full CRT reconstruction/modular inversion, parameter and split-descriptor construction, macro forward/inverse keys, complete E evaluation, production placement, ordinary callee, precision/native/outer theorem remain separate. No new κ or frontier change. README/TASK record a concrete full-evaluator follow-up.

Base/current canonical main12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244, priority7; task uniform-transfer-audit refined to this component. Live handoffs and focused evaluator Discussions plus309 open/draft PR bodies checked; broader Discussion/closed/code coverage partial. Distinct from PR4174 placement, PR4169 repair, PR4187 tail, and completed PR4186 Gaussian solve. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4173#discussioncomment-19070631

Credit Cinna Davis’s PR4100 (337d04939571a637aeab54a0f58f54fde811663a), Hiroki KUMAZAKI’s PR4174 context, Douglas Colkitt/OpenAI framework and complete retained NOTICE lineage. ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; separate-agent review is not independent human or proof-assistant acceptance. New work Apache-2.0. Maintainer edits disabled; no merge requested.

python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/crt-benes-scan --check-only
